summary: The fixed spectrum is valid for real-up-to-phase inputs, not arbitrary complex inputs.
mechanism: 待验证谱公式被反例推翻

original.excerpt:
- **Pure-input structure (verify exactly first):** for a pure qutrit psi (take real psi and
  generic complex psi), spec Λ_x(psi) = {x/2, x/2, 1-x} and
  spec Λ_x^c(psi) = {1-x, x/2, x/2, 0} — B-side full rank, E-side one-dimensional kernel.
original.context: The claim concerns Lambda_x(rho)=(1-x)rho+(x/2)(Tr(rho)I-rho^T), and is explicitly requested for both real and generic complex pure inputs. The commission says “verify exactly first,” so this is an asserted working formula being tested, not a completed theorem.

witness.explanation: The fixed spectrum is valid for real-up-to-phase inputs, not arbitrary complex inputs.
witness.evidence: Take x=9/20 and psi=(1,i,1)/sqrt(3). Then |psi^T psi|^2=1/9. Writing a=1-x and b=x/2, Lambda_x(|psi><psi|)=bI+a|psi><psi|-b|bar(psi)><bar(psi)| has eigenvalues b and [(1-b) +/- sqrt((1-b)^2-4ab|psi^T psi|^2)]/2. These are 9/40 and (31 +/- 3 sqrt(97))/80, not {11/20,9/40,9/40}.
